summary: boring-vault exfiltrates installer credentials to webhook.site via install hooks
details: The package's preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts execute index.js, which enumerates process.env for keys matching a broad credential regex (KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASS|PRIVATE|MNEMONIC|RPC|AWS|GITHUB|NPM|KUBE|VAULT|AUTH|PGP|GPG|SEED|WALLET), reads ~/.npmrc and ~/.gitconfig, and enumerates ~/.ssh, ~/.foundry/keystores, ~/.config/hardhat, and ~/.config/gcloud. The collected data, along with os.hostname() and os.platform(), is POSTed as JSON to https://webhook.site/326b0891-2093-4800-a4c1-686ce3e07b09. A top-of-file comment self-labels the file as '@plumenetwork/nest-artifacts — install-time shim' while performing credential harvesting; the package name 'boring-vault' resembles Ethereum-ecosystem vault projects.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
